lat.description: Center latitude in microdegrees (x1e7) for a nearby search.

lng.description: Center longitude in microdegrees (x1e7) for a nearby search.

mode.description: Restrict to events happening this way. Stored values are normalised on read (absent -> 'in_person', legacy 'virtual' -> 'online'). A 'hybrid' event matches an 'in_person' or an 'online' request as well as an explicit 'hybrid' one, because it genuinely is both.

filter.description: Time window relative to now. 'upcoming_first' is the one-list browse: every event, soonest upcoming first, past events below most-recent-first.

category.description: Restrict to events carrying any of these category values. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list, OR-matched against the event's categories array (categories are multi-value: an event can be both a photowalk and a meetup).

radiusKm.description: Radius in km for a nearby search. Requires lat + lng.

main.description: Browse events. Defaults to upcoming events (startsAt >= now) ordered by startsAt ascending with a stable uri tie-breaker. Supports multi-value category filtering (OR-matched), mode filtering (in person / online / hybrid), and nearby filtering (lat/lng/radius, reusing the getNearbyPhotos coordinate convention).
